Pick a recipient from a menu

description: **Twink Post adds a menu of your own characters to the Send Mail tab, so sending to an alt takes one click instead of typing its name.**
- Remembers every character of your account when you log in: realm, class, level and faction.
- A small button next to the recipient box lists your characters in their class colours, with their level.
- A click fills in the recipient. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
- Characters on connected realms are included and filled in as Name-Realm.

Log in once with each character. At a mailbox, open the Send Mail tab and click the arrow next to the recipient box. `/tp` (or `/twinkpost`) lists every known character, `/tp forget Name` removes one.
- Works on Retail. No combat data, it only reads your own character's name, realm, class, level and faction.
- Your own faction comes first. The game lets your characters mail each other across factions on the same or a connected realm.
- The character you are playing is left out.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
